variant.title: Same Values Sudoku
variant.description: Regions with the same label contain the same digits, including repeated digits.
rule.same_values: The two regions carrying the same label have identical digit multisets.
rule_guide.title: Same Values Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: Each row, column, and 3x3 box must contain no repeated digit.
rule_guide.item_2: The two regions marked with the same letter must contain the same digits.
rule_guide.item_3: The order of the digits does not matter, but repeated digits must occur the same number of times in both regions.
